bug_semantics: OliveTin JWT authentication accepts a validly signed token whose aud claim does not match the configured authJwtAud when the token is verified with a local RSA public key (authJwtPubKeyPath) or HMAC secret (authJwtHmacSecret). parseJwtTokenWithLocalKey and parseJwtTokenWithHMAC call github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5 jwt.Parse with only a keyfunc and no jwt.WithAudience option, so golang-jwt never checks audience. The sibling remote JWKS path parseJwtTokenWithRemoteKey does pass jwt.WithAudience(cfg.AuthJwtAud). An attacker who holds a token minted for a different audience/service that shares the signing material can authenticate (WhoAmI and other JWT-gated APIs). ACL authorization is not bypassed; this is authentication-time audience non-enforcement (CWE-287/CWE-345).
flaw_origin: The CVE mechanism is incomplete jwt.WithAudience wiring, not the original HMAC parser. PR #269 member 5fe07448584b9392f6763126fc72adf2151f66f1 (tree-identical GitHub squash 8341b1d6d090fec783c50bcdd910a1d057e9dba8 on main) upgraded to golang-jwt v5, replaced the OIDC header verifier with keyfunc JWKS, introduced three sibling parse functions, and applied jwt.WithAudience(cfg.AuthJwtAud) only to parseJwtTokenWithRemoteKey. Local-key and HMAC jwt.Parse were rewritten in that same commit without the option. Parent dd11961a11ba27b6e65e4375f338b9fe1a981501 has no WithAudience; AuthJwtAud was then only oidc.Config.ClientID on a separate header path. Earlier HMAC jwt.Parse without audience (0949999840c115841a7e3fb82158c8c268a1298a, 2022-08-24) and local RSA jwt.Parse (PR #145 member 71561c893b63da7d9121a2b555a74fff37a68b06, squash 6e2e585175b7a0021e27b3a4dbf48cd85d987098) predate AuthJwtAud and jwt.WithAudience, so they are not this CVE's BIC. Later path moves (ff31abe6, be7c7540, a62d58f1) only relocated the same omission.

reasoning: CVE-2026-30223 / GHSA-g962-2j28-3cg9 is a real, published (not withdrawn/rejected) authentication flaw: authJwtAud is enforced on remote JWKS jwt.Parse and ignored on local-key and HMAC jwt.Parse, so a wrong-audience token signed with the configured key authenticates. The advisory's own contrast (remote jwt.WithAudience vs local/HMAC jwt.Parse with only a keyfunc) is the mechanism. That contrast did not exist until PR #269. Parent dd11961a still parsed local RSA and HMAC with jwt.Parse and used AuthJwtAud only as oidc.Config.ClientID on a distinct header verifier; jwt.WithAudience is absent there, so the incomplete ParserOption control is a first-write, not a move of the later missing-option lines. HMAC jwt.Parse without audience (09499998) and local RSA jwt.Parse (71561c89) are earlier related omissions, but they predate AuthJwtAud and the jwt v5 WithAudience API this CVE names; treating them as BIC would invert the advisory into a generic 'never checked aud' claim. 5fe07448 is the reconstructable public member (same tree and parent as squash 8341b1d6); the squash itself is not used as BIC. Immediate parent was verified present (introducer_parent_absent=false) and lacks WithAudience. The omission then survived directory moves and the 3k auth rebuild until e97d8ec, which is the direct fix and is in 3000.11.1 but not 3000.11.0.
